C0291.title: When Verification Codes Became a Harassment Tool: Who Was Behind It?
C0291.summary: In February 2023, the Cybersecurity Brigade of Daying County Public Security Bureau in Suining, Sichuan received a tip from the provincial cyber police about websites offering 'call-bombing' services and SMS bombing software. Investigations found that the suspect surnamed Xiong modified SMS bombing source code obtained online, hijacked registration interfaces of multiple commercial websites to control their SMS verification platforms, and developed a 'Super SMS Bomber' program capable of continuously sending verification code messages to a specified phone number, selling the service through a self-built site with illicit profits of over 100,000 yuan. As of the report Xiong had been placed under criminal detention.
